description: Classical baselines on the exact v3 TEST instances: sim.instances(n, N, TEB=32e9), N=200 at n=14 else 100 (seeds listed). Target = all satisfying assignments (E==0), same success set as v3core.succ_D, so 1/p of the quantum circuit and classical costs share the target. Per-instance value = mean over 200 independent runs (expected cost to FIRST hit a satisfying string); then median / B90 (90th pct) across instances.

units.quantum: 1/p = expected circuit shots (each shot = 1 sample, + 1 classical check)
units.random_guess: expected uniform samples = 2^n / nsol (each = 1 energy eval)
units.flips: number of single-variable flips (accepted moves) until first hit
units.evals: WalkSAT: 1 initial + 4 break-count evaluations per step (one per variable of the chosen unsat clause); SA: 1 per random restart + 1 per Metropolis proposal (delta-energy)

settings.walksat: SKC WalkSAT: pick random unsat clause; if some var has break 0 flip it (freebie), else w.p. p random var in clause, else min-break var. p=0.5 (best of {0.1..0.7} on n=20 TRAIN set; n=8 train is degenerate and prefers p=0.7, near random walk). No restarts (cap 2e8 never hit).
settings.SA_tuned_n8train: single-flip Metropolis, random var proposal, beta linear 1.0->2.0 over 5n proposals per restart, restart until hit; tuned on 200 n=8 TRAIN instances (grid b0{.2,.5,1}xb1{2,3,5}xsteps{5,20,50,200}n), criterion (log med+log B90)/2 of evals
settings.SA_tuned_n20train: same, beta 1.0->3.0 over 50n proposals; tuned on 50 n=20 TRAIN instances (base 31e9, disjoint from test); flat optimum (scores 7.44-7.47 for several settings)
